Headline: #12 Roosevelt buses Temporary Reroute at Roosevelt/Cicero
ShortDescription: The #12 Roosevelt buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions, due to a street blockage near Roosevelt/Cicero.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
The #12 Roosevelt buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions via Roosevelt, Cicero, 16th, Kostner, Roosevelt and over regular route near Roosevelt/Cicero, due to a street blockage.

Allow extra travel time.
